title: Design-based SEM with svysem
text: estimator = "MLM" maximum likelihood Satorra-Bentler adjustment. complete continuous data. regression mean structure free covariates matches design used survey::svyglm(). estimator = "MLR" robust maximum likelihood Yuan-Bentler adjustment. missing = "ml" scores row indicators row observed. sampling weight incomplete row stays design. estimator = "WLSMV" ordered indicators. point estimates use lavaan’s weighted diagonally weighted least squares matrix. standard errors use replicate weights. strata, default replicate type stratified jackknife.
code: regression <- svysem(   "y ~ x1 + x2", design,   fixed.x = FALSE, meanstructure = TRUE ) coef(regression) #>   y~x1   y~x2   y~~y x1~~x1 x1~~x2 x2~~x2    y~1   x1~1   x2~1  #>  0.441 -0.483  0.880  0.726 -0.085  0.958  0.902  0.088  0.104 incomplete <- design incomplete$variables$y2[c(1, 8, 15)] <- NA mlr <- svycfa(   "f =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4", incomplete,   estimator = "MLR", missing = "ml" ) mlr@estimator #> [1] "MLR" lavaan::lavInspect(mlr, "nobs") #> [1] 48 frame <- design$variables frame$a <- ordered(findInterval(frame$y1, c(-0.5, 0.5))) frame$b <- ordered(findInterval(frame$y2, c(0))) frame$c <- ordered(findInterval(frame$y3, c(-0.4, 0.6))) ordinal <- survey::svydesign(   ids = ~psu, strata = ~strat, weights = ~w, data = frame ) ordered_fit <- svycfa(   "f =~ a + b + c", ordinal,   estimator = "WLSMV", ordered = c("a", "b", "c") ) ordered_fit@variance_method #> [1] "replication"

text: Design-based estimation structural equation models uses model 'lavaan' design 'survey' input, including subpopulation taken subset(). Sampling weights, strata, primary sampling units enter variance way 'Mplus' TYPE=COMPLEX (Oberski (2014) doi:10.18637/jss.v057.i01 ). design-based covariance sample moments goes 'lavaan' raw data weights. svysem(), svycfa(), svygrowth() three fitters. svysem() fits structural equation model, svycfa() confirmatory factor analysis, svygrowth() growth curve. result extends 'lavaan' fit, coef(), vcov(), fitMeasures() design-based. completed data set multiple imputation fitted pooled Rubin's rules (Rubin (1987) doi:10.1002/9780470316696 ). pooled_estimates() pooled_wald() use survey design's degrees freedom complete-data degrees freedom (Barnard Rubin (1999) doi:10.1093/biomet/86.4.948 ). fitMeasures() reports pooled scaled chi-square mean, minimum, maximum robust fit indices. indices pooled Rubin's rules. Continuous data fit maximum likelihood Satorra-Bentler adjustment, robust maximum likelihood (MLR) Yuan-Bentler adjustment, including missing = "ml". multigroup MLM fit uses replicate weights, -group contrast keeps covariance primary sampling units contain one group. Ordered indicators use WLSMV: point estimates use weighted diagonally weighted least squares weight matrix, standard errors use replicate weights. predict() returns factor scores continuous outcomes. replicate-weight design accepted.

title: svysem 0.3.1
text: parameterEstimates() standardizedSolution() svysem fit include standard errors confidence intervals. lavaan’s functions omit columns unless se = TRUE, object’s first class svysem rather lavaan. MLR lavaan 0.7 uses lavScores() returned. version already multiplies casewise scores sampling weight. Multiplying made sandwich large.

title: svysem 0.3.0
text: Multigroup MLM (group=) uses replicate-weight standard errors. per-group NACOV drop covariance groups primary sampling units overlap groups. chi-square fit maximum-likelihood statistic. predict() returns posterior-mean factor scores continuous outcomes, plausible values draws positive. lavaan::lavPredict() weighted fit lavaan 0.6-21 return scores. WLSMV ordered indicators. Point estimates use lavaan’s weighted diagonally weighted least squares matrix. Standard errors use replicate weights (survey::.svrepdesign(), type "auto" unless replicate.type set). Continuous WLSMV passes ordered = FALSE, lavaan 0.7 requires indicator ordered. svyrep.design accepted MLM, WLSMV, MLR. variance_method "replication". MLR continuous outcomes, including missing = "ml". variance design-based sandwich casewise scores, Yuan-Bentler statistic uses sandwich. Listwise deletion keeps incomplete rows design weight 0. Defined-parameter standard errors use delta method. Multiple imputation accepts MLM, WLSMV, MLR. parallel loops imputations; replicate weights inside one imputation stay sequential. Three vignettes: design-based fit, multiply imputed designs, comparison lavaan, lavaan.survey, Mplus.

title: svysem 0.0.1
text: CRAN check fixes. coef, vcov summary registered S3 methods, unused numDeriv import removed, examples need mitools guarded. R 4.2.0 newer required. coef() vcov() pooled object also S4 methods, still run lavaan turns generics S4 methods. Standardized pooling requests lavaan standard errors se = TRUE. svyrep.design refused svysem_error_design.
